thread:
maria: Heads-up — the catalog PR I opened updates fallback guidance for a few variants but the CLI example still shows the old `rw model` syntax. Can we sync briefly before merging?

kevin: I noticed that. The current recommended CLI is `rw models fallback set ...`. I'll patch the snippet.

kevin: Proposed snippet (to replace the old block):
```bash
# set fallback for aurora-7b to nebula-3b with cost-aware policy
rw models fallback set --model aurora-7b --fallback nebula-3b --policy cost
```

oliver: Also flag: the compatibility table for aurora-7b still says "quantized: CPU". Our bench runs show OOMs on 4GB CPU setups — should be "quantized (GPU only)" or list a minimum CPU size.

maria: Good catch. I'll update the table row and add a short note about minimum RAM for CPU quantized runs.

sam: I can update the S3 benchmark link too — current link 404 in the PR. Also discovered an SDK snippet in examples/python that uses `model_id=`; the SDK now expects `model=`. I'll push a tiny fix.

jen: Please add a one-line note in the changelog about the CLI flag rename so users don't get surprised. I'll draft it after you push.

ci-bot: CI: docs build failed — linkcheck error: /docs/catalog/aurora-7b#fallback-syntax -> 404

kevin: Pushed a patch to PR 1350 that updates the CLI snippet, rephrases the fallback paragraph, and adds an inline note about CPU memory requirements. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1350

maria: Taking a look now. @jen I'll want the changelog entry to mention the CLI command change and the SDK param rename.

sam: Updated S3 path and fixed SDK param in examples/python. Ran `make linkcheck` locally — passed. Pushed commit.

ci-bot: CI: re-run queued.

ci-bot: CI: build passed. docs deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-1350--docs.redwood.ai/catalog/aurora-7b

maria: :thumbsup: Looks good on preview. Merging after a quick smoke test on staging.

kevin: Thanks — I also added a short note in the snippet about when the fallback is applied (only on capacity constraints, not for latency tiers).

oliver: Once merged, I'll schedule a tiny bench re-run to update the "expected throughput" row with the new quant profile numbers.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. If anything else pops up, comment on PR 1350.
